_comment: Per-device voice-latency acceptance baselines (MASTER 4.8). A live battery (voice_live_bench.py --device <kind>) compares its P50/P95 TTFW + VAQI against the ceiling/floor here and flags a REGRESSION if it drifts past them. ttfw_*_ms are CEILINGS (higher = worse), vaqi_floor is a FLOOR (lower = worse).
_status: The numbers below are ESTIMATES until recorded. To record REAL numbers for a device: run `voice_live_bench.py --device <kind> --record` on that device with a working LLM — it measures the BRAIN-PATH battery (respond_stream) and rewrites that device's envelope (ceiling = measured x1.4/x1.3, floor = measured VAQI - 8), adding a `measured` block. NOTE: this captures brain-path latency, not true acoustic mic->STT->brain->TTS->speaker; full acoustic acceptance is captured by the live edge's TTFWMeter during real use (edge/latency_meter.py). laptop = recordable here; airpods/mentra/iphone/android need the physical device.

laptop.note: open speakers, half-duplex; the reference device

airpods.note: private endpoint, barge-in on; slightly higher VAQI floor (no self-interrupt risk)

mentra.note: glasses over network transport; a little more latency headroom
